import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
import socket
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path


def ws_connect(ws_url):
    assert ws_url.startswith("ws://")
    host_port, path = ws_url[5:].split("/", 1)
    host, port = host_port.split(":")
    sock = socket.create_connection((host, int(port)), timeout=10)
    key = base64.b64encode(os.urandom(16)).decode()
    req = (
        f"GET /{path} HTTP/1.1\r\n"
        f"Host: {host}:{port}\r\n"
        f"Upgrade: websocket\r\n"
        f"Connection: Upgrade\r\n"
        f"Sec-WebSocket-Key: {key}\r\n"
        f"Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13\r\n\r\n"
    )
    sock.sendall(req.encode())
    buf = b""
    while b"\r\n\r\n" not in buf:
        buf += sock.recv(4096)
    return sock


def ws_send(sock, text):
    payload = text.encode("utf-8")
    mask = os.urandom(4)
    header = bytearray([0x81])
    length = len(payload)
    if length < 126:
        header.append(0x80 | length)
    elif length < 65536:
        header.append(0x80 | 126)
        header.extend(struct.pack("!H", length))
    else:
        header.append(0x80 | 127)
        header.extend(struct.pack("!Q", length))
    header.extend(mask)
    masked = bytes(b ^ mask[i % 4] for i, b in enumerate(payload))
    sock.sendall(bytes(header) + masked)


def ws_recv(sock):
    def read_exact(n):
        data = b""
        while len(data) < n:
            chunk = sock.recv(n - len(data))
            if not chunk:
                raise EOFError("WebSocket closed")
            data += chunk
        return data

    b1, b2 = read_exact(2)
    length = b2 & 0x7F
    if length == 126:
        length = struct.unpack("!H", read_exact(2))[0]
    elif length == 127:
        length = struct.unpack("!Q", read_exact(8))[0]
    if b2 & 0x80:
        mask = read_exact(4)
        payload = bytes(b ^ mask[i % 4] for i, b in enumerate(read_exact(length)))
    else:
        payload = read_exact(length)
    return json.loads(payload.decode("utf-8"))


class CDP:
    def __init__(self, ws_url):
        self.sock = ws_connect(ws_url)
        self.msg_id = 0

    def call(self, method, params=None):
        self.msg_id += 1
        cid = self.msg_id
        ws_send(self.sock, json.dumps({"id": cid, "method": method, "params": params or {}}))
        while True:
            msg = ws_recv(self.sock)
            if msg.get("id") == cid:
                if "error" in msg:
                    raise RuntimeError(msg["error"])
                return msg.get("result", {})

    def close(self):
        self.sock.close()


def main():
    edge = r"C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe"
    html_url = Path("services.html").resolve().as_uri()
    user_data = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="edge_cdp_")

    )
    try:
        targets = None
        for _ in range(30):
            try:

            except Exception:

        assert targets, "Could not connect to Edge CDP"
        ws_url = targets[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"]
        cdp = CDP(ws_url)
        cdp.call("Page.enable")
        cdp.call("Runtime.enable")
        time.sleep(0.6)

        def eval_js(expr):

        time.sleep(0.2)
        before = eval_js("({ scrollY: window.scrollY, hash: window.location.hash, scrollWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, innerWidth: window.innerWidth, cardCount: document.querySelectorAll('#all-specialties .specialty-detail-card').length, btnHref: document.getElementById('viewAllServicesBtn').getAttribute('href') })")
